notes: One typescript contents-table page headed TABLE DES MATIERES, with typed pagination - 538 - and lower-left archive number 84. No date is visible. It lists AVANT-PROPOS, INTRODUCTION, a CHAPITRE O/0 heading, and three sections containing 7, 10, and 7 live numbered subentries (24 total). Two obsolete entries, old 2.4 and a number-only 2.5, remain visibly cancelled above the replacement 2.4 and 2.5? entries. The dotted right-hand fields contain no page-number digits. The live 2.5 ends in a literal typed question mark; its role as deliberate authorial doubt or a typing anomaly is not established. A left marginal mark permits a question-mark interpretation but its function remains uncertain; its strokes have been drawn. The handwriting is assigned only to an unnamed hand. H is description only: no H readings or H differences are asserted, and H’s historical identification or attribution is not used as ink evidence. No mathematical proof or computation was performed.
math_reading_decisions: The C-context title target was checked: TABLE DES MATIERES has no visible grave accent on the capital E; the unaccented spelling is retained.

The two C-context obsolete row targets were checked: 2.4. Fonctions constructibles and the following 2.5. are cancelled; the replacement 2.4 and 2.5? are live. The replacement 2.4 has no dotted leader.
The live 2.5? punctuation is a hooked typewritten question mark with a low point, not a full stop; the matter is also recorded in decision A085-05.

All section numbers, decimal reference fields, terminal points, the semicolon after Noyaux, word hyphens, apostrophes, accents, and dotted leaders were read individually. 2.10.Applications has no intervening word space after the numbering point.
The body contains no displayed or inline formulas requiring a mathematical proof check. Retaining O/0 is a glyph decision, not a claim about intended chapter numbering.
